recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a portrait-first browser game titled **Bus Simulator 2K: Chrome Route**. Preserve a one-button side-scrolling driving runner: the bus auto-drives, the player taps/clicks/presses Space or ArrowUp to jump only while grounded, rival traffic collisions end the run, cyber rider pickups award +5 score, speed pressure increases over time, and restart resets the run. Transform the presentation into a satirical cyberpunk bus simulator with chrome aesthetic, neon noir skyline, retro leaderboard energy, meme-tone copy, procedural chrome bus art, green rider pickups, red/magenta traffic hazards, compact mobile HUD, synthesized arcade audio, and approved catalog fonts/GIF feedback. Do not add steering, braking, lives, upgrades, or altered scoring.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: one-button side-scrolling arcade driving runner
- objective: keep the bus alive while collecting rider pickups for score
- input model: start/restart buttons, then tap/click/Space/ArrowUp to jump only when grounded
- core loop: run forward automatically, spawn traffic obstacles and rider pickups, jump to avoid/collect, score rider pickups, speed escalates over time
- fail/friction state: axis-aligned collision with traffic obstacle ends the run and reveals restart/final score

## Protected Mechanics
- Single-thumb jump input and keyboard jump input.
- Gravity, grounded jump gating, continuous animation loop, obstacle collision failure, rider pickup scoring, restart flow, and gradual speed pressure.
- Score semantics remain rider pickups worth +5; no new scoring systems are introduced.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title/menu copy, bus/car/rider drawing style, background skyline/road identity, particles, fonts, sound feedback, GIF reaction overlay, color palette, chrome UI panels, and progression labels are safe because they do not alter collision, scoring, or input semantics.
